validation: TP1 on one B300, per the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 dossier (180B total / 6B active, 172.78 GiB FP8 on disk, 131 shards, 185502232570 bytes, HF revision 236dfdf2 pinned; native ctx 262144; fits the 268.6 GiB measured on curiosity with ~25% margin, KV fp8 ~4 GiB per 262K context). engine_args are the TP1 grid of that dossier verbatim: no --enforce-eager (lesson from GLM-5.3: launch-bound x12), no expert parallelism at TP1, MTP k=3 on the single MTP layer, FP8 KV plus indexer_kv_dtype fp8, qwen3_coder tool parser, qwen3 reasoning parser, vision/video disabled for text-only serving. Parsers are given explicitly, so parser_candidates is intentionally absent (profile_check rejects both). VLLM_ENABLE_CUDA_COMPATIBILITY=0: the node driver 580.126.20 rejects the CUDA-compat mode with cudaErrorSystemDriverMismatch (803); multi-GPU container runs proved it without that mode, TP1 included. Placement: nodelist dgx16 is an operator order; dgx15 is excluded because /run/nvidia-persistenced/socket is missing there, so every CDI container creation fails. The checkpoint is already installed at checkpoints/qwen38-flash-fp8 (131/131 sha verified), so install is not needed: preflight re-verifies config.json, tokenizer_config.json and all 131 shards readable and non-empty, and the docker image (pinned by digest) is pulled on the node. Measured on the identical grid as a manual submit (job 12256, dgx16, 28 Oct 2026): submit to INFERENCE_READY 7m35s, model load 241s, engine init 161s, 7/7 API checks, tool-call and needle OK, bs1 decode median 235 tok/s (steady ITL ~301), MTP k=3 acceptance mean length 2.54. Roofline for this model at bs1 is 300-500 tok/s, so k is still an open question; k=0..3 is being replayed on this controller.
